description: Read the espresso machine's live state: boiler temperature and target, group pressure, scale weight, water level, switch positions, and uptime. Use this to answer 'is it ready', 'what profile is loaded', or 'is it low on water'. Values are instantaneous — call again for a fresh reading rather than reusing an old one.
name: get_status

brewActive.description: True while the brew switch is engaged and a shot is pulling

profileName.description: Brew profile currently selected on the machine

steamActive.description: True while the steam switch is engaged

targetTemperatureC.description: Temperature the PID is holding for, in degrees Celsius

upTimeSec.description: Seconds since the machine was last powered on

waterLevelPercent.description: Water tank level as a percentage, 0-100

weightG.description: Current reading from the scale, in grams

title: Get machine status

description: Get the id of the most recently recorded shot. This is the entry point for any shot question that does not already name an id — call it first, then pass the id to get_shot_data or view_shot_graph.
name: get_latest_shot_id

shotId.description: Id of the most recently recorded shot, or null when the machine has no shot history

title: Get latest shot id

description: Summarize one shot: duration, final weight against the profile's target, peak pressure, water pumped, time to first drip, temperature stability, and a phase-by-phase breakdown with pressure/flow/weight sampled at each phase's entry, midpoint, and exit. This is the right tool for dial-in advice and for comparing shots — prefer it over get_shot_raw_data, which returns hundreds of raw samples to say the same thing.

shot_id.description: Id of a shot stored on the machine, e.g. "1706547890". Call get_latest_shot_id to obtain the most recent one; ids of older shots come from a previous response.

name: get_shot_data

outcomeMetrics.description: Headline numbers for the whole shot

finalWeightG.description: Weight in the cup at the end of the shot, in grams

peakPressureBar.description: Highest pressure reached during the shot, in bar

profileName.description: Name of the brew profile used

shotId.description: Id of the shot this summary describes

targetWeightG.description: Weight the profile was set to stop at, in grams; null when the profile has no weight stop condition

tempStability.description: Human-readable temperature verdict: "stable", or "drifted +N.NC" when the spread exceeded 1°C

timeToFirstDripSec.description: Seconds from shot start until the scale first read above 0.5 g; null when no drip was detected

waterPumpedMl.description: Total water pushed through the puck, in millilitres

durationSec.description: Length of this phase, in seconds

events.description: Notable events detected within this phase

phaseNumber.description: 1-based position of the phase in the shot

samples.description: Readings sampled at the start, midpoint, and end of the phase

entry.description: Reading at the start of the phase

flow.description: Pump flow at this point, in ml/s

pressure.description: Pressure at this point, in bar

weight.description: Weight in the cup at this point, in grams

exit.description: Reading at the end of the phase

flow.description: Pump flow at this point, in ml/s

pressure.description: Pressure at this point, in bar

weight.description: Weight in the cup at this point, in grams

mid.description: Reading at the midpoint of the phase

flow.description: Pump flow at this point, in ml/s

pressure.description: Pressure at this point, in bar

weight.description: Weight in the cup at this point, in grams

type.description: Phase type as named by the profile, e.g. "FLOW" or "PRESSURE"; "UNKNOWN" when the profile does not name it

title: Get shot summary

description: Get every raw datapoint recorded for one shot: the full pressure, flow, weight, and temperature time series, already converted out of the machine's scaled wire format. The response is large. Only reach for it when the summary from get_shot_data is genuinely not enough — for example to inspect the exact shape of a pressure ramp.

shot_id.description: Id of a shot stored on the machine, e.g. "1706547890". Call get_latest_shot_id to obtain the most recent one; ids of older shots come from a previous response.

name: get_shot_raw_data
title: Get raw shot datapoints

description: List the documented brew profiles with their control type, suited roast levels, target ratio, and target time. Returns each profile in full, so no follow-up call is needed to describe one. These come from this server's bundled documentation, not from the machine, so a profile the user created themselves may not appear.
name: list_profiles

profiles.description: Every documented profile, complete — no follow-up call needed

basketNotes.description: Basket and dose notes for this profile, when documented

description.description: What the profile does and when to reach for it

id.description: Id to pass to get_profile_info, e.g. "zer0"

name.description: Display name as shown on the machine

roastLevels.description: Roast levels this profile suits, e.g. ["light", "medium"]

targetRatio.description: Intended brew ratio, e.g. "1:2" (dose to yield)

type.description: Control strategy the profile uses, e.g. "flow" or "pressure"

title: List brew profiles

description: Get the full documentation for one brew profile, including its prose description. Call list_profiles first if you do not already have a profile id.

profile_id.description: Id of a documented profile as listed by list_profiles, e.g. "zer0".

name: get_profile_info

basketNotes.description: Basket and dose notes for this profile, when documented

description.description: What the profile does and when to reach for it

id.description: Id to pass to get_profile_info, e.g. "zer0"

name.description: Display name as shown on the machine

roastLevels.description: Roast levels this profile suits, e.g. ["light", "medium"]

targetRatio.description: Intended brew ratio, e.g. "1:2" (dose to yield)

type.description: Control strategy the profile uses, e.g. "flow" or "pressure"

title: Get brew profile details

description: Get the expert system prompt for espresso dial-in: how to read a shot, which variable to change next, and the documented profiles. Call this before giving dial-in advice so the advice matches this machine and this user's setup.
name: get_dial_in_guidance
title: Get dial-in guidance

description: Renders an interactive espresso shot graph. Shows pressure, flow, weight flow, and weight over time with target profiles overlaid. Automatically annotates key metrics (peak pressure, first drip) on the chart. Optionally compares two shots side by side — the user can also click 'Compare previous' in the graph to load the prior shot without a new tool call.

compare_shot_id.description: Optional id of a second shot to overlay on the same axes for comparison.

shot_id.description: Id of the shot to visualize, e.g. "1706547890". Call get_latest_shot_id to obtain the most recent one.

name: view_shot_graph
title: View shot graph

description: Raw shot data as a JSON document, for the shot graph UI to plot. Not intended for the model — call get_shot_data for anything you need to reason about.

shot_id.description: Id of a shot stored on the machine, e.g. "1706547890". Call get_latest_shot_id to obtain the most recent one; ids of older shots come from a previous response.

name: get_shot_raw_json
title: Get raw shot JSON
